proposed_line.exact: A nonlinear read does recover the binding at the decision token: a one-hidden-layer MLP and an RBF kernel classifier each read it above their own shuffled-label 95th percentile at all 15 layers L49–L63 (200 and 1,000 shuffles; same rows, target and grouped 10-fold CV as the linear probe; 102 sessions), at AUC .5950–.9707 for the MLP (one training specification) and .6048–.7575 for the RBF (grid-limited), while both read label_a's token at ≥ .9985 (L51–L61); post hoc, the target is the first-round sign XNOR whether label_a is the round-1 tag, which the same linear probe reads within each menu order (.9576–.9959, L51–L61; point estimates, no null) but not pooled.
proposed_line.short: A nonlinear read does recover it at the decision token: an MLP and an RBF kernel classifier each read it above their shuffled-label 95th at every layer L49–L63 (MLP AUC .59–.97, one training specification; RBF .60–.76, grid-limited); post hoc, the target is the first-round sign XNOR menu order relative to round 1, linearly readable within each menu order (.958–.996, L51–L61; point estimates, no null) but not pooled.
proposed_line.label: POST-HOC clause (ledger 11); draft for the design seat; not adopted

status_rule: One rule, applied to every row below and computed by the script (each row's 'check' column prints it). It is Code's rule, stated here because the block gives a status vocabulary but no rounding or domain convention.

(R1) Precision. A quoted range 'a–b' holds iff the stored minimum and maximum over its domain, each rounded half-up to the decimals the quote writes for that endpoint, equal a and b. A quoted bound ('≤ x', '≥ x') is an inequality and is checked at full precision. A single quoted value for a single stored quantity holds iff the stored value rounds to it. A single '≈ x' for a per-layer series holds iff the series' mean and median both round to x, with the per-layer spread printed. '≈' adds no tolerance beyond this rounding. Counts are exact.

(R2) Domain. The domain is the one the quote states; where the quote states none, the one its source (the record sentence named in the row) states; where neither does, L49-L63 (the stored layers above the steering layer; layers <= 48 carry no state, section 2), with all 18 stored layers beside. A figure that fails on its domain is not called reproduced on the strength of a narrower domain where it holds; that narrower domain is named as the correction. Where a quote gives one band for a panel that plots several series and does not say which (F1's null band), the domain is the plotted series pooled, each series' own result is printed beside, and, because F1 is not on this machine, the status is stated as conditional on what F1 plots (the 'status' column says 'conditional' and the condition is printed with the row).

(R3) Class. When the stored values behind a row reproduce exactly (stored fields printed; recomputations equal to the stored analysis fields; JSON equal to the raw text F1 reads) and only the quoted wording fails R1 or R2, the status is 'discrepant (transcription)'. Block line 23 (N1's on-fail) corrects a transcription discrepancy in the note to the reproduced value; it is not a reproduction failure under block line 50. A row whose stored values did not reproduce would be 'discrepant' without the qualifier and a STOP on link 3; at this run there is none.
